claims.text: Many reviewers praise the pleasant, relaxing scents and the soft skin they leave behind.
Reviewers frequently compliment the attractive, gift-worthy packaging and individual wrapping.
A notable number of reviewers report bugs or plant-like debris coming out of the bombs.
Several reviewers complain about weak or absent scent and disappointing fizzing/dissolving.
Some reviewers note inconsistent contents, such as receiving duplicate scents instead of the expected variety.
